changelog: **Mentorship request expiry and cancellation (#1775):** `MentorshipRequest` gains `expiresAt` (set to created + 14 days on every create path: the mentee form, re-match, the public apply link), `nudgeSentAt`, `cancelledById` and `cancelReason`, and `MentorshipRequestStatus` gains `CANCELLED` and `EXPIRED` (additive). The rule is pure in `src/lib/requestExpiryRule.ts` (unit-tested): ONE nudge on day 7 to the named mentor (or the org's admins for an unnamed or re-match request), expiry on day 14, a pre-column request reading as createdAt + 14 days. `src/lib/requestExpiry.ts` is the only writer — guarded `updateMany`s, so a rerun or an overlapping decision changes nothing — run by the new queue job `requests.expirySweep` at 09:10 (and `/api/cron?job=mentorship-requests`). A PENDING request past its expiry no longer satisfies the `already_pending` guard, so the mentee is free at once. `decideMentorshipRequest()` gains `action: 'cancel'` (ADMIN route only, a reason required, guarded on PENDING); the mentee is notified with the reason. The admin queue gets a cancel-with-reason form and an "expires in N days" badge; the mentee's panel shows the countdown and the expired/cancelled outcome. New in-app notifications `mentorship_request.nudge|expired|cancelled` (EN/TR/DE + MARKETING overlay).

en: A mentorship request nobody answers now gets one reminder after a week and closes after 14 days, so the mentee can ask someone else; administrators can also withdraw a request with a reason the mentee sees.
tr: Yanıtlanmayan bir mentorluk talebi artık bir hafta sonra bir kez hatırlatılıyor ve 14 gün sonra kapanıyor, böylece mentee başka birine başvurabiliyor; yöneticiler de bir talebi mentee'nin göreceği bir gerekçeyle geri çekebiliyor.
de: Eine unbeantwortete Mentoring-Anfrage wird jetzt nach einer Woche einmal in Erinnerung gerufen und nach 14 Tagen geschlossen, damit der Mentee jemand anderen fragen kann; Administratoren können eine Anfrage außerdem mit einem Grund zurückziehen, den der Mentee sieht.
